subject: general
question: Kumari Kamala was awarded with Padma Bhushan in 1970. She is a preeminent artist of the ______ tradition of the dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vazhuvoor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumari Kamala** was awarded with **Padma Bhushan** in **1970** for her contribution to the **Vazhuvoor tradition **of the dance.
 
• **Vazhuvoor **is a style of** Bharatanatyam,** a classical dance form originated in **Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• It is named after the **village Vazhuvoor in Tamil Nadu,** where the style was developed and promoted by the **dance guru Pandanallur Meenakshisundaram Pillai.**
 
• Vazhuvoor style is characterized by its** graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive abhinaya **(facial expressions).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi **is another classical dance form originated in **Andhra Pradesh, India.**
 
• **Tamzara** is a folk dance form of **Armenia**, and **Kurdish** is a folk dance form of **Kurdistan. **
